subject: Taxes
title: The Double Irish Dutch Sandwich
description: One-minute skill: The Double Irish Dutch Sandwich.

hook.text: Google routed profits through Ireland to the Netherlands to Bermuda—paying taxes in none of them.

buildup.text: Step 1: An Irish company licenses IP to a Dutch company.

discovery.text: Each transfer reduced taxable income. The profit ended up in Bermuda at a 0% rate. Google saved billions annually.

twist.text: Ireland closed the Double Irish to new users in 2015 but gave existing users until 2020 to transition.

climax.text: The sandwich was perfectly legal and saved tech companies over $100 billion.

punchline.text: Ireland to Netherlands to Bermuda. Zero tax. The $100 billion sandwich.

quiz.question: Where did profits end up in the Double Irish Dutch Sandwich?
